source: Existing 60-run evidence manifest and input partition identities only. No predictions, outcomes, abstention counts or reference answers are read.
run_selection: Sort SHA256(seed|runs|stratum|run_id); choose first 10 per stratum. The reserved stratum has exactly ten runs, so all are included.
object_assignment: Sort the five object names by SHA256(seed|objects|stratum|object_id); assign that permutation cyclically to ranked runs. Exactly two units per object per stratum, one unit per run.
neutral_identifiers: Sort selected units by SHA256(seed|display|run_id|object_id), assign NV01..NV20. Both reviewers receive all twenty identical cases, with reviewer-specific form metadata only.
exposure_limit: This is prediction-blinded human annotation of known audit cohorts, not a claim that recordings or reviewers are fully unseen. Original partition exposure disclosures are retained privately.
scope: r1-initial-table-support-v3-20261024; unchanged; original four annotation categories and definitions.
reviewer_equivalence: Identical videos, measurements, object assignments, protocol, case summaries and order. Only reviewer identifier and return-archive name differ.
prediction_seal: The already sealed 300-case V3 predictions will be compared only after independent submissions, adjudication, explicit human approval and reference freeze. No accuracy is reported now.
